name: physical-engineering
description: Build and measure a synthetic drone battery tray and electronics bridge, revise requirements, and reproduce a consistent CAD handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Measure an engineering change from brief to CAD handoff.
interface.longDescription: A bounded physical-engineering workflow for a synthetic civilian drone battery tray and removable electronics bridge. Preserve requirements, measure exported geometry, demonstrate a wider-battery fit failure, revise the design, and regenerate reproducible fabrication files through separately installed Text-to-CAD.
defaultPrompt: Use $engineer-subsystem to start a drone-module study in an empty directory and show its requirements.
Use $verify-engineering-design to measure my drone module and report failed or unknown requirements.
Use $prepare-engineering-handoff to regenerate verified CAD, drawings, BOM and the reproduction package.
